urls.title: Pages to watch
urls.description: The pages to check. Each entry is an object with url (required) and selector (optional CSS selector, for example "#changelog" or "main .status"). With a selector, only that part of the page is watched and the rest is ignored. Without a selector, the whole page body is watched, which is noisier. A plain string is also accepted and means the whole page. Each entry that is read counts as one charged page check.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before each request after the first one. Keep it at 1 or more to stay polite. If the site's robots.txt asks for a longer Crawl-delay, the longer value is used.

requestTimeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a response before the URL is reported as a timeout. A URL that times out is not charged and its stored fingerprint is left untouched.

excerptChars.title: Excerpt length
excerptChars.description: How many characters of the watched text are kept in previous_excerpt and current_excerpt, so you can see what changed without opening the page. Set 0 to store no text at all.
